request_envelope.occurred_at_rule: must parse and must not be more than 300 seconds in the future
request_envelope.server_rule: remote enqueue overwrites actor_projection_id with authenticated Public session projection_id before validation/hash/storage

remote_enqueue.request: deferred envelope; actor_projection_id is server-authored from session
remote_enqueue.capability_rule: kind maps to a required projected capability and is checked at enqueue
remote_enqueue.idempotency: unique installation_id + request_id; same canonical envelope returns existing state/result; different canonical envelope returns request_id_conflict

remote_list.access_rule: wildcard capability may list installation rows; ordinary session only rows matching its actor_projection_id

remote_result.access_rule: actor access is checked by public_deferred_actor_can_access

local_claim.lease_expiry_rule: expired lease clears lease_token/lease_expires_at while state remains pending_sync
local_claim.selection: oldest pending_sync unleased row ordered by occurred_at, created_at, request_id
local_claim.lease_token: 32 random bytes returned as 64 hex chars; historical deferred implementation stores the token value in deferred_work for lease comparison

local_ack.state_rule: state must be deferred terminal state committed|needs_review|rejected
local_ack.terminal_dedupe_rule: if current state is terminal and equals target, return deduplicated=true; different terminal target returns terminal_state_conflict
local_ack.lease_rule: non-terminal row must be pending_sync and lease token must match

local_reconcile.transition_rule: only needs_review may transition to committed or rejected; if current already equals target return deduplicated=true

local_period_status.validation: both strict date strings and to_date >= from_date

semantic_invariants: Public enqueue persists pending_sync only and is never final business success.
Local revalidates active user/capability, expected state/version, module readiness and financial-period rules.
Local canonical domain owner performs the business commit.
Receipt/result persistence precedes ACK so reclaim after lost ACK cannot duplicate business effect.
Conflict or closed-period work can become needs_review.
Review resolution is explicit and audited; no silent financial-period reopen/back-post.
Realtime and deferred stores/claim paths remain separate.
v3_note: This captures proven deferred-safe semantics from dev39. Final V3 endpoint/schema compatibility remains draft until executable producer/consumer migrations are complete.
